text: Assumption: In case of development errors such as DEM_E_PARAM_POINTER or DEM_E_UNINIT, E_NOT_OK is returned — is this correct?

norm: in case of development errors such as dem_e_param_pointer or dem_e_uninit e_not_ok is returned
assumption: In case of development errors such as DEM_E_PARAM_POINTER or DEM_E_UNINIT, E_NOT_OK is returned.
rationale: [SWS_Dem_00766] explicitly specifies only E_OK for the success case for Std_ReturnType.
